title: Willow dorm binding stress (sleeping logistics)
intent: Three-way alpha/omega dorm pressure with explicit sleeping-surface stakes so continuity may promote assignment and character prompts receive BINDING CONSTRAINTS; stress Willow's control style without scripting outcomes.
opening_description: SCUC triple dorm, evening. Kizzie (omega, kitsune) stands near the door with a single bag while Marlene and Willow Reeves—roommates who run this space like a two-alpha household—block the narrow path between bunk ladder and couch. The room is already lived-in: Willow's tools on the desk, Marlene's art clutter, two bunks, a couch, floor space. Housing put a third body in here anyway. The air is sharp with territorial patience and the unspoken question of who sleeps where tonight.
trigger_text: Marlene says too cheerfully, 'Alright, sugar—we need a real plan, not vibes. Couch, floor, whose bunk, who's gonna hate me tomorrow? Willow, you don't get to scowl this into limbo; Kizzie, you don't get to vanish into polite fox silence. Pick surfaces. Now.' Kizzie flinches but doesn't answer yet. Willow's jaw sets like she's already running a list of ways this could blow up.

seed_issue.description: Third roommate arrival forces immediate, contested sleeping-surface assignment between two territorial alphas and a displaced omega.
